entries.name: Nohad El Shami
entries.text: CNEWA reports that Nohad El Shami was partially paralyzed after a stroke in January 1993. Her son Saad prayed at Saint Charbel’s hermitage and brought back blessed oil and soil. According to her family, she dreamed of surgery by Saint Charbel and another monk on January 22; when she awoke, she had two neck scars. She then made a monthly pilgrimage to Annaya for the rest of her life.
entries.source: Reported account - CNEWA, "Lebanon’s Beloved Saint" (interviews with the Shami family)

entries.name: Antonio Ishaac
entries.meta: Lebanon - recorded at the monastery, October 2025
entries.text: In an interview with CNEWA, Antonio Ishaac said he had stopped treatment for Crohn’s disease in December 2024. He visited the monastery in May 2025 and prayed; he reported that his pain vanished after an intense night. He said later tests showed the disease had disappeared. CNEWA reports that the monastery recorded his account in October 2025.

entries.name: Mariam Assaf Awad
entries.text: Charbel App’s account says Mariam Assaf Awad underwent several cancer operations between 1963 and 1965. She prayed for healing through Saint Charbel’s intercession in 1967 and reported that her symptoms were gone the next morning. The Church accepted her healing as the miracle for his canonization in 1977.
entries.source: Historical summary - Charbel App, Saint Charbel canonization account

entries.name: Sister Maria Abel Kamari
entries.meta: Sisters of the Sacred Hearts - July 1950 - a beatification miracle
entries.text: Charbel App’s account says Sister Maria Abel Kamari, bedridden with severe illness and paralysis, recovered after visiting Saint Charbel’s tomb at Annaya in July 1950. The Church approved her healing among the miracles for his beatification in 1965.
entries.source: Historical summary - Charbel App, Saint Charbel canonization account

entries.name: Iskandar Naim Obeid
entries.text: Charbel App’s account says Iskandar Naim Obeid, a blacksmith from Baabdat, lost sight in one eye after a metal fragment struck it. On pilgrimage to Annaya in 1950, he reported a dream of a monk touching his eye and said his sight returned. The Church approved his healing among the miracles for Saint Charbel’s beatification.
entries.source: Historical summary - Charbel App, Saint Charbel canonization account

entries.name: Brian K. Kravec
entries.text: Brian reports that severe femur pain disappeared after he prayed for Saint Sharbel’s intercession and used relic oil. He says follow-up X-rays showed a healthy femur. This is a personal ministry account, not a Vatican-recognized miracle.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony of Brian K. Kravec

entries.name: Renny Palmisano
entries.text: Renny reports that a scan first appeared to show a cancer recurrence. After praying a novena and asking for Saint Sharbel’s intercession, a later review by her oncology team identified inflammation and scar tissue instead. She describes the outcome as an answered prayer.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony of Renny Palmisano

entries.name: Victor G. Akroush
entries.text: Victor’s family describes severe stomach pain and a difficult medical diagnosis. They asked Saint Sharbel to intercede before treatment and report that Victor later recovered. The account is presented by the Family of Saint Sharbel USA as a personal testimony.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony of Victor G. Akroush

entries.name: Vanessa El Fghali
entries.text: Vanessa’s mother reports praying to Saint Sharbel for her daughter’s spinal condition and asking for his intercession. The ministry account says Vanessa’s recovery was later confirmed by medical follow-up.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony for Vanessa El Fghali

entries.name: Nader Ahmad Al-Sawwaf Zantout
entries.text: After a serious accident left Nader in a coma with fractures and paralysis, his family and monks at Annaya prayed for Saint Sharbel’s intercession. The published account says he regained consciousness and recovered.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony of Nader Ahmad Al-Sawwaf Zantout

entries.name: Tani Youssef Wehbeh
entries.text: Tani’s testimony describes a serious leg condition during surgery and a reported intervention attributed to Saint Sharbel. The account says his leg was saved from major amputation.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony of Tani Youssef Wehbeh

entries.name: Sharbel Said Nassif
entries.text: Sharbel’s family reports praying with blessed water and soil from Saint Charbel’s tomb after he was diagnosed with a serious heart condition. The published testimony says later medical results showed recovery.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony of Sharbel Said Nassif

entries.name: Georgiane Walker
entries.text: Georgiane reports that a post-surgery wound that had not healed closed after she prayed to Saint Sharbel and used his oil. The testimony was later featured by EWTN News; it remains a personal account rather than a Church-certified miracle.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony of Georgiane Walker

entries.name: Rita Antoine Kirakos
entries.text: The ministry account says Rita regained hearing in her right ear after prayer for Saint Sharbel’s intercession. The testimony was recorded by the ministry in July 2024.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony for Rita Antoine Kirakos

entries.name: Hoda Antoine Chalhoub
entries.text: Hoda’s testimony says she was diagnosed with lung cancer and later received clear test results after prayers to Saint Sharbel. The published account identifies this as a ministry-recorded testimony, not a Vatican ruling.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony of Hoda Antoine Chalhoub

entries.name: Thérèse Youssef Khoury Fahd
entries.text: Thérèse’s account describes a brain tumor and a planned operation. The published testimony says the tumor disappeared after prayers to Saint Sharbel and that doctors confirmed the change.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony of Thérèse Youssef Khoury Fahd

entries.name: Elias Youssef Rahmeh
entries.meta: Sin El Fil, Lebanon - healing testimony recorded 2024
entries.text: Elias’s ministry-published testimony says he was diagnosed with rectal cancer and later received tests showing recovery after prayer to Saint Charbel. The source presents this as a recorded personal testimony.
entries.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA - Healing Testimony of Elias Youssef Rahmeh
